summary: A flat-to-firm start is in prospect as Asia rebounds and metals carry strong results, but fresh Gulf supply risk and a tired rally into a holiday keep buyers selective.

detail.leaders: Metals, after strong Q2 numbers from Hindalco and Tata Steel and Nuvama upgrades
detail.laggards: Tech-linked names after last week's AI-driven selloff abroad, and oil users if Gulf risk lifts crude
detail.tone: A forward-looking read before the open: GIFT Nifty points to a flat-to-slightly-higher start after Sunday's Muhurat hour gave back its gains. Today is the only session before Tuesday's holiday.
watch: Whether metals lead after the Hindalco and Tata Steel results
Brent's move on reports of attacks on Saudi energy sites
Whether foreign buying resumes after the Diwali break
